capex.statement: Investing in AI-era capabilities including Zero-Gravity Telco Architecture, Consumer Agentic Experience Studio, Toronto Innovation Hub, Engineering Experience Center, and Indus-Terra 30B parameter model
capex.quote: We continue to strengthen TechM Helix through strategic investments in industry solutions, engineering capabilities, and our people. Zero-Gravity telco architecture and Consumer Agentic Experience Studio are part of this effort to make AI more relevant to clients' business needs.

pricing_cost.statement: Adopting outcome-based pricing models combining human and agent token economics; early successes in F&A processes and telco use cases
pricing_cost.quote: We have seen some early successes where clients want to use that in specific portfolios. We have seen some successes in F&A processes where the clients are looking at using our Vector Squad-based pricing to really start looking at driving outcomes which was different from a typical FP or a T&M kind of contracts.

risk.statement: Expect normal seasonality in H2 FY27; some weakness in European auto manufacturing but manageable within portfolio
risk.quote: No, we expect normal seasonality. We continue to see some weaknesses in our European auto manufacturing business, but those are all manageable within the existing portfolio that we have.

other.statement: Partnered with Quantum Technology Foundation for India's indigenous 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer; completion expected December 2026
other.quote: In quantum technologies, we partnered with Quantum Technology Foundation to develop middleware for India's indigenous 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer. Completion is expected by December 2026, with commercialization activities expected thereafter.

other.statement: Return on capital employed 31.2% for quarter, up 290 bps Q-o-Q and 680 bps Y-o-Y
other.quote: Our return to capital employed stood at 31.2% for the quarter, reflecting a sequential improvement of 290 basis points. On a Y-o-Y basis, the ROCE improved by 680 basis points.

guidance.statement: Revised deposit growth guidance to 11-12% from 9-11%
guidance.quote: On guidance, I had guided for deposit growth of 9-11%, and I am revising that to 11-12%.

guidance.statement: Revised advances growth guidance to 13-14% from 11-13%
guidance.quote: I had guided for advances growth of 11-13%, and I am revising that to 13-14%.

guidance.statement: Expects NIM expansion of 5-6 basis points in Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: On NIM, I expect expansion of around 5-6 basis points this quarter, because deposits, including bulk deposits, will reprice later.

guidance.statement: Expects advances growth of 14-15% in next quarter
guidance.quote: Even so, I expect advances growth of 14-15%, and I am comfortable with that; it will not fall substantially.

demand.statement: Advances grew 16.39% YoY; corporate 9.92%, RAM 17.74% (retail 17.37%, agri 17.18%, MSME 19.06%)
demand.quote: Advances grew by 16.39%. Corporate advances grew by 9.92%, almost in double digits, while RAM advances grew by 17.74%. All segments are growing evenly: retail grew by 17.37%, agriculture by 17.18% and MSME by 19.06%.

demand.statement: Targets corporate growth of 10-12% with capacity building initiatives
demand.quote: In corporate, I am targeting growth of 10-12%. Corporate growth is also a function of capacity building; earlier, our corporate growth was only 1-2%.

demand.statement: Agricultural gold loan book grew 22% YoY to Rs.1.16 lakh crore, up 11% QoQ
demand.quote: The agricultural gold-loan book has grown by around 22% year-on-year, to Rs.1.16 lakh crore. So it has grown by around 11% on Q-o-Q basis sequentially, from Rs.1.04 lakh crore to Rs.1.16 lakh crore.

margin.statement: NIM improved 8 bps YoY; domestic NIM up 1 bp QoQ, global NIM up 2 bps QoQ
margin.quote: NIM improved by 8 basis points on a year-on-year basis. Domestic NIM increased by 1 basis point and global NIM by 2 basis points on Q-o-Q basis.

margin.statement: Cost of deposits up 9 bps QoQ; yield on advances up 8 bps QoQ; yield on investments up 2 bps QoQ
margin.quote: The cost of deposits increased by 9 basis points sequentially. The yield on advances increased by 8 basis points sequentially, and the yield on investments increased by 2 basis points sequentially.

margin.statement: Corporate yield improved from 8.36% to 8.49% QoQ
margin.quote: The corporate yield is 8.49%, compared with 8.36% in June.

order_book.statement: Corporate credit pipeline stands at Rs.63,000 crore with Rs.30,000 crore sanctioned but undisbursed
order_book.quote: The corporate credit pipeline stands at Rs.63,000 crore. Of this, Rs.30,000 crore has been sanctioned and is yet to be disbursed, in-principle approval has been given for Rs.10,000 crore, and the remaining around Rs.23,000 crore is under discussion or at a preliminary stage.

capex.statement: Approved raising up to Rs.5,000 crore through Infrastructure Bonds
capex.quote: We have taken approval to raise up to Rs.5,000 crore through Infrastructure Bonds, and we may go for that.

product_mix.statement: MCLR-linked book 43.19%, external benchmark-linked 49.65%; repo rate hike benefit started immediately on external benchmark book
product_mix.quote: The MCLR-linked book constitutes 43.19% of advances, and the external benchmark-linked book constitutes 49.65%. As you all know, the repo rate has been increased by 25 basis points, so we should see NIM expansion of perhaps 5-6 basis points going forward.

risk.statement: ECL models will take 1.5-2 years to stabilize; regulator may challenge assumptions
risk.quote: I will wait and watch for one year, because this is a new concept. It will take 1.5-2 years for the models to stabilize. They will be challenged, there will be a lot of discussion, and the regulator may not accept all our assumptions.

risk.statement: No stress seen in SME, agri, retail; drought exposure minimal (<Rs.1,000 crore)
risk.quote: Very candidly, nothing is reflecting so far. I cannot say what may emerge suddenly, but as of now there is no stress.

other.statement: Gross NPA 1.61%, Net NPA 0.14%, slippage ratio 0.69% down 8 bps QoQ
other.quote: Gross NPA declined to 1.61%, and net NPA stood at 0.14%. The slippage ratio was 0.69%, a decline of 8 basis points from the previous quarter.

other.statement: SMA book declined to 4.19% (Rs.29,748 crore) from 7.35% a year ago; SMA-2 above Rs.25 crore only Rs.400 crore
other.quote: The SMA book declined from 7.35% a year ago to 4.19%, or Rs.29,748 crore in absolute terms. SMA-2 accounts above Rs.25 crore amount to only around Rs.400 crore.

guidance.statement: USD 1 billion revenue target by late FY29 or early 2030, includes transformer + backward integration product sales, no additional capex needed
guidance.quote: It will be late part of FY29 or early 2030.

guidance.statement: Confident of achieving FY27 guidance of 25% revenue growth and 9-10% PAT margin
guidance.quote: Following our Q2 performance, we remain confident of achieving FY27 guidance and continue to remain on track with our growth plans for the full year.

guidance.statement: Maintain FY27 guidance of 25% revenue growth and 9-10% PAT margin
guidance.quote: So, our target is to reach a growth of 25% and beyond. So, we are keeping it the same.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 16.1% vs 8.8% YoY and 13.3% QoQ, driven by operating leverage and utilization
margin.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 16.1% compared to 8.8% in Q2FY26 and 13.3% in Q1 FY27. This reflects the benefit of higher operating leverage and improved utilization level during the quarter.

margin.statement: Backward integration expected to add 200-300 bps margin expansion, full effect by FY29
margin.quote: So, we are looking at around 200 basis point to 300 basis point margin expansion through this backward integration.

order_book.statement: Unexecuted order book at Rs 7,237 crore as of 30 Sep 2026, up 32% YoY, executable over 18-24 months
order_book.quote: As of 30th September 2026, our unexecuted order book stood at 7,237 crore, up by 32% year-on-year, providing strong revenue visibility over the medium term. The order book is executable over the next 18 to 24 months.

order_book.statement: Order inflows of Rs 1,169 crore in Q2 FY27, 97% YoY growth
order_book.quote: During Q2 FY27, we received order inflows of 1,169 crores, 97% year-on-year growth over low base of last year this time.

order_book.statement: Rs 21,000 crore of inquiries under negotiation, 80% domestic and 20% export, equal government-private mix
order_book.quote: We currently have 21,000 crores of inquiries under negotiation, of which bidding for 80% is domestic orders and 20% export orders, with equal mix between the government and private customers, with utilities and industrial customers.

capex.statement: Moraiya EHV expansion to start after Changodar completion, 30% capacity addition from freed insulation space, target FY28 production
capex.quote: And pl us what will happen with our insulation and pressboard plant com ing live, the manufacturing place for insulation, which was at Moraiya, will now be added to transformer manufacturing unit. So, we will be adding about 30% plus manufacturing capacity at Moraiya

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material prices (transformer oil, CRGO) remain high but majority of orders have price variation clauses limiting margin impact
pricing_cost.quote: Yes. So sir, the prices, etcetera, are still on the higher side. But what we have, we have a majority of order which is having, say, a price variation clause. So mainly, it does not affect our margin in a big way.

product_mix.statement: Nuclear transformer content 15-18% of greenfield nuclear project cost
product_mix.quote: So, greenfield nuclear new projects would be close to about 15% to 18%.

product_mix.statement: BESS transformer inquiries ongoing, expect orders in current quarter, market assessment underway
product_mix.quote: No. We are not currently executing any BESS pipeline. But yes, there are inquiries that are currently ongoing, and we are sure that in this quarter we should get some orders for BESS transformers.

risk.statement: HVDC converter transformer qualification 1.5 years away (repair 4-5 months, testing 6-7 months, then tender participation)
risk.quote: So, we are currently repairing the transformer, so with that will be another four to five months' time, then the successful running of that transformer will take another six to seven months. And then we will qualify for the manufacturing, and then we will start participating into the tender. So at least one and one and half months one and half year is away from when we are speaking.

other.statement: Target capacity utilization of 90%, currently working towards it
other.quote: So ideally, I would want a capacity utilization of about 90%, and we are constantly working and we are constantly progressing towards that.

other.statement: Target working capital cycle of 110-120 days by end of FY27 to generate positive free cash flow
other.quote: It should be below 120 days. We are trying to, you know, reach at 120, and once we reach there, we would like to see close to between 110 days and 120 days this year.

guidance.statement: Management expects festive shift of ~INR40 crore advertising revenue from Q2 to Q3 FY27 and remains optimistic on next two quarters despite geopolitical concerns
guidance.quote: we believe there is an impact of almost around INR40 crores. Now with that shifting into Q3 and the overall momentum, what we believe is there, though in certain parts of India, the monsoon is not playing well because in Rajasthan, even there's a rains happening even today.

guidance.statement: Management endeavors to achieve high single-digit to early double-digit full-year advertising revenue growth
guidance.quote: That's what our endeavor is. Looking at this -- what we've seen in the last 7, 8 days of festival, overall momentum is good. let's hope this continues.

demand.statement: Festive season shift (Navratri moved from Q2 to Q3) impacted YoY advertising comparison; underlying advertising revenue grew positive single-digit excluding festive shift
demand.quote: As you know, last year, Navaratra festival season was in Q2, and this year, it falls in Q3. So on a like -to-like basis, D. B. Corp advertising revenue and EBITDA registered positive single -digit growth in Q2 excluding the impact of this festive shift.

demand.statement: Real estate advertising flat to single-digit; jewelry strong double-digit; banking/financial services and IPO advertising up ~50% (small base); healthcare strong double-digit; auto flat; education single-digit; FMCG down 2% YoY but ~single-
demand.quote: Real estate single digit, ideally, this should have been good double digit, but because of the real festival season going this way. So most of them are almost flat or single digit.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA INR124 crore vs INR115 crore YoY; PAT INR69 crore vs INR93 crore YoY; H1 EBITDA INR289 crore vs INR297 crore YoY
margin.quote: EBITDA stood at INR124 crores compared to INR115 crores in the corresponding quarter last year, while profit after tax stood at INR69 crores against INR93 crores.

order_book.statement: Circulation at ~38 lakh copies (37.68 lakh in Q2 vs ~38 lakh prior quarter); ~30,000 copies lost QoQ; focus on maintaining core market share, non-core markets less concerning
order_book.quote: We are at around 38 lakh copies. If you compare the last quarter, numbers are almost the same. So all efforts are there to make sure that we continue having the base, but a f ew percentage here and there is the one which is bothering us.

capex.statement: No major capex planned for next 4-5 quarters; all machines and production equipment in place
capex.quote: we don't have any large capex planned because all the machines, production e quipments and all are all in place. So we don't see -- foresee any major capex coming in a couple of quarters or maybe 4, 5 quarters ahead.

pricing_cost.statement: Advertising pricing: upgrading advertisers from inside pages to premium pages (front, back, third page) to increase ticket size; no discount on premium page rates
pricing_cost.quote: What we are doing on the pric ing side, we are able to increase the ticket size, which means the advertiser who was advertising on inside page, we've been able to upgrade them, take some extra money from them and bringing them on to the premium pages of back page, third page and the front page also.

product_mix.statement: Digital app subscription price hiked from INR149 to INR199 on experimental basis (cohort testing); too early to quantify revenue impact; advertising, subscription and tie-ups all nascent
product_mix.quote: First of all, the price hike, which we have taken from INR149 to INR199, this will all be experimental basis. It's not a flat. Some places we have even tried slightly lesser, even monthly price and all that.

product_mix.statement: Digital MAU declined from 20M (Q4) to 18M (Q2) due to reduced marketing spend and subscription experiments; QoQ decline ~3-4%
product_mix.quote: We have tried to reduce the marketing spend on this entire activity because we believ e now brands should be able to sustain the readers' base based on th eir own merits and the organic. So we have reduced the marketing spend.

risk.statement: Geopolitical situation a concern for newsprint costs and overall demand outlook; monsoon irregularities in Rajasthan may affect near-term advertising
risk.quote: Especially I'm more concerned about the geopolitical situation. But having said that, looking at the overall momentum which our country has, I'm pretty optimistic on the next 2 quarters also.

other.statement: Newsprint cost per tonne increased ~21% YoY from INR47,000 to ~INR57,000 due to geopolitical situation; domestic prices follow imported; freight also higher; expects 2-3% softening in Q3-Q4
other.period: Q2 FY27, Q3 FY27, Q4 FY27
other.quote: What we were paying INR47,000 per tonne average cost, we are paying right now almost INR57,000. So there are almost 20.8% to be more precise 21% is the impact on the newsprint cost.

other.statement: Cash and bank balance ~INR1,120 crore; first interim dividend INR5/share paid in Q1; further distribution to be decided by Board
other.quote: As on today, company has a total cash and bank balance of around INR1,120 crores. And as you know, the company has already paid INR5 per share as the first interim dividend in the Q1.

guidance.statement: Management aspires for high-teens revenue growth in FY27 and double-digit growth over the long term.
guidance.quote: Over the long term, we want to aspire for a double-digit growth. And yes, for the year, we are expecting a high teens, and that's what we've just said.

guidance.statement: Management does not provide quarterly guidance.
guidance.quote: So unfortunately, I can't guide you towards next quarter or thereon.

demand.statement: Almond Drops Hair Oil delivered double-digit unit volume growth across pack groups and channels, led by small and medium packs.
demand.quote: Almond Drops Hair Oil continues with its strong performance in this quarter and has delivered double -digit unit volume growth.

demand.statement: General trade and organized trade both grew in the strong mid-20s; rural grew marginally ahead of urban; quick commerce is the fastest-growing sub-channel.
demand.quote: This quarter saw continued momentum in our general trade channel, which grew in line with organized trade, and both channels delivered growth in the strong mid-20s.

demand.statement: International business grew ahead of company average in H1 except Bangladesh which grew in the teens due to tough environment.
demand.quote: This channel for the full H1 has grown ahead of the company growth, and except for Bangladesh, most of our other ke y markets individually have also grown ahead of the company average.

margin.statement: Gross margin 59.9% in Q2 and 60.8% in H1; sequential reduction offset by fixed and employee cost savings.
margin.quote: Our gross margins for the quarter were at 59.9%, and overall for the first half of the year at 60.8%.

margin.statement: Focus is on growing absolute EBITDA pool rather than percentage margin in inflationary environment.
margin.quote: One, see, in an inflationary environment, our attempt is to protect and grow the absolute EBITDA pool rather than a percentage EBITDA pool.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 25%, PAT margin 21%; H1 EBITDA INR167 cr (85% growth), PAT INR141 cr (75% growth).
margin.quote: On margins, we delivered an EBITDA of INR53 crores with an EBITDA margin of 25%, and a PAT of INR70 crores with a PAT margin of 21%.

capex.statement: Outsourced Guwahati factory production to third-party facility at start of FY27 for better operating efficiencies.
capex.quote: So, see, what has happened is that we have outsourced basically the production of one of our factories in Guwahati from a company-owned facility to a third-party-run facility to drive better operating efficiencies towards the beginning of this financial year.

pricing_cost.statement: Calibrated price increase of ~5% in Q3 split roughly equally between 2-3% frontal price increase and similar contribution from ml-age reductions.
pricing_cost.quote: In this round, we are approximately taking a 5% increase in consumer price, which will be split roughly equally between frontal price increase of 2% to 3% and a similar contribution coming through ml-age reductions.

pricing_cost.statement: Endeavor to pass on absolute cost increases rather than protect percentage gross margin; peers also taking price hikes.
pricing_cost.quote: And we are taking price increase which we believe would be sufficient to cover the kind of a cost impact we would need to manage our overall P&L.

product_mix.statement: Relaunched and launched new SKUs in growth portfolio: refined amla oil proposition, upgraded body lotion product and packaging, Banjara's packs extending into large adjacent categories.
product_mix.quote: In amla oils, we have refined the consumer proposition and are testing the new mix in general trade. In body lotion, we have upgraded both the product and packaging, and will test it on e-commerce. In Banjara's, we have introduced packs that extend the brand into large adjacent categories, which could offer significant growth potential for us if we are successful.

product_mix.statement: Test marketing Banjara's lip balm and color shampoo (INR15) in four southern states to leverage herbal equity and expanded distribution.
product_mix.quote: We are test marketing these in Banjara's markets core markets only, which are the four southern states. The belief which we have is Banjara's is a company which has been there in these markets for many decades, and hence, there is a very strong equity around the herbal, natural, you know, brand values which exist.

risk.statement: Biggest risk from changing consumer preferences impacts less than 1-1.5% of households; category has 91%+ penetration.
risk.quote: This is a category of ours where we operate which has a 91% plus penetration, which means nearly every single household in the country uses this. The change in demographics or the change in preferences which possibly you're referring to is what we see impacting less than maybe 1% to 1.5% of the households in the country.

risk.statement: Rural demand concerns (El Nino, harvest) are a while away; government easing measures underway; management remains optimistic.
risk.quote: See, I think it's early, but we remain optimistic. At the same point of time, I would say it is early because, you know, whatever concerns which we are talking about which included you talked about in terms of rural demand, El Niño, they are all a while away.

other.statement: A&P spend up 7% YoY in Q2 and 18% in H1; optimized non-working A&P and reworked media operating cycles for spend efficiencies.
other.quote: Our consolidated A&P spend for the quarter were up 7% over the same period last year, and are up 18% on H1 basis. We continue to maintain robust SOV/SOM ratios in traditional and digital media, and we have carefully optimized the non -working A&P and reworked our media operating cycles to create some spend efficiencies.

other.statement: Unit volume growth reported as toughest measure; excludes free volume impact; ADHO unit volume growth double-digit.
other.quote: So, the reason why we've given and reported unit volume is because it does not take into account any free volume, any benefit on account of volumes going inside it. And hence, it is a reflection of how many bottles get sold or how many times the consumer has come and bought it.

guidance.statement: AUM growth guidance of 30%-35% CAGR and profitability growth of 35%-40% CAGR
guidance.quote: Guidance, we will maintain 30% to 35% CAGR from the AUM perspective, and 35%-40% CAGR from profitability perspective.

guidance.statement: Target to reach INR10,000-11,000 crores AUM in 2-3 years
guidance.quote: Maybe 2 years to 3 years is the target for us to reach INR10,000 or INR11,000 kind of number.

guidance.statement: Digital lending to contribute ~10% of overall AUM in 2-3 years
guidance.quote: If I were to look at our journey of INR10,000 crores in next 2 to 3 years, I think digital lending should contribute around 10% to our overall AUM.

guidance.statement: Maintain ROA >4.5% and cost-to-income <15%
guidance.quote: We have also achieved all our key operating parameters: maintained nil NPA, return on assets is more than 4.5% and cost-to-income continues to remain less than 15% and we plan to maintain this in quarters to come as well.

margin.statement: Interest cost as % of income rose due to higher leverage (asset-to-equity 2.8x to 3.7x)
margin.quote: Leverage. Our asset-to-equity has gone up from 2.8x to 3.7x in last two quarters. So when the leverage goes up, mathematically the interest cost will go up. But it translates to a better return on equity.

margin.statement: Yield maintained at ~13% (12.5% ROI + 50-70bps fee income)
margin.quote: we're maintaining 13% kind of a yield. 12.5% odd as a ROI and around 50 basis point to 70 basis point as fee income, both put together, around 13% is the yield on our overall AUM whi ch we are

margin.statement: Cost of borrowing ~8% from 19 bank/NBFC relationships
margin.quote: Our cost of borrowing is around 8%. That is something unheard for NBFCs of our size and scale.

order_book.statement: Loan book at all-time high of ~INR5,700 crores in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: Our loan book is also at an all-time high of around INR5,700 crores.

order_book.statement: Factoring contributes ~15% of loan book
order_book.quote: Around 15% contribution to our book is coming from the factoring.

order_book.statement: Disbursed >INR16,000 crores in H1 FY27 (46% YoY growth)
order_book.quote: We continue to leverage our digital infrastructure and disbursed loans of more than INR16,000 crores in H1, which means volumes of INR32,000 crores on an annualized basis, which translates to less than 2 months of payback cycle for our loan book. This volume, if you were to compare on a year-on-year basis has gone up by 46%.

capex.statement: 15% strategic stake in AI/digital technology subsidiary for in-house stack
capex.quote: We believe from a data security perspective, and from the dependency perspective, having an in-house AI digital stack is a better way forward. That's why we are beginning with a small 15% stake, which is more strategic and a long-term in nature.

product_mix.statement: Launched Factoring, TReDS, digital lending (BharatPe), and loan against property in Q2
product_mix.quote: Apart from dealer financing and deep-tier financing, we have started doing Factoring and TReDS. We have also commercialized digital lending and loan against property during the quarter.

product_mix.statement: Sector mix: ~35% steel/building products, ~20% auto, rest pharma, IT, tiles, electricals, cables
product_mix.quote: If I were to dissect it, around 35% would be steel and building products, another 20% odd would be auto, and then there are varied industry, we are into pharma, IT, Tiles, Electricals, Cables, so on.

fund_raise.statement: No equity raise planned this financial year; leverage increased to 4x instead
fund_raise.quote: No. Our mid-term target was to not leverage ourselves beyond debt-to-equity of 3x. But now considering the growth which has front-loaded, we are revising our leverage to debt-to-equity of 4x.

risk.statement: Digital lending NPA risk mitigated via FLDG, in-built cushions, anchor-led model
risk.quote: NPA does happen. But philosophy of the group is very simple - nil NPAs. And that we want to maintain in BharatPe arrangement also. Maybe at a gross level, NPA may be there. But what matters whether NPAs are hurting us or not. So we have in-built cushions in form of better commercial or FLDG from LSPs.

other.statement: Accumulated provisions ~INR25 crores (regulatory ECL/IRAC, not cash credit cost)
other.quote: Today, we have accumulated maybe around INR25 crores kind of provisions in our balance sheet, which adds to our overall strength of the balance sheet, and that's the requirement of the regulator.

other.statement: Debt-to-equity leverage cap revised from 3x to 4x; board approved incremental borrowing
other.quote: Our mid-term target was to not leverage ourselves beyond debt-to-equity of 3x. But now considering the growth which has front-loaded, we are revising our leverage to debt-to-equity of 4x. Today in our board meeting also, board has approved the incremental borrowing, so we would like to leverage ourselves more.

guidance.statement: No growth guidance provided; focus on sustainable VNB growth over medium term
guidance.quote: We don't provide guidance. We can give you what we should look at from the medium term.

demand.statement: Retail protection growth expected to moderate from 40-50% to more moderate levels in H2 FY27
demand.quote: The expectation is that as you get into H2 of this year, those growth numbers should taper down from the 40%-50% that we've been seeing to more moderate levels.

margin.statement: VNB margin expanded 130 bps to 26.0% in H1 FY27 driven by product mix shift toward protection
margin.quote: VNB margin stood at 26.0%, an expansion of 130 basis points from the full-year margin of 24.7% last year.

order_book.statement: VNB grew 22.3% YoY to ₹12.83 billion in H1 FY27; total premium grew 15.3% to ₹245.05 billion
order_book.quote: VNB growing by 22.3% to ₹ 12.83 billion in H1 -FY2027, and margins stood at 26.0%. Total premium grew by 15.3% year-on-year to ₹ 245.05 billion.

order_book.statement: Sum assured grew 30.1% YoY to ₹8.81 trillion; retail sum assured up 34.9% to ₹2.32 trillion
order_book.quote: In H1-FY2027, our sum assured grew by 30.1% to ₹ 8.81 trillion, supported by a strong 39.5% year-on-year growth in protection APE.

capex.statement: 54% of savings policies issued same day reflecting straight-through processing and automation progress
capex.quote: In H1-FY2027, 54% of our savings policies were issued on the same day, reflecting the progress we have made in straight -through processing and automation.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost to Premium ratio ex-GST reduced 30 bps to 18.3%; Savings Cost to Premium ex-GST reduced 90 bps to 11.6%
pricing_cost.quote: Our Cost to Premium ratio, excluding GST, reduced by 30 basis points year -on-year to 18.3% in H1-FY2027, and the Savings Cost to Premium ratio, excluding GST, reduced by 90 basis points year-on-year to 11.6% over the same period.

pricing_cost.statement: Operating expenses ex-GST and stamp duty reduced at 8% CAGR over 3 years; 22% absolute reduction in FY26 vs FY23
pricing_cost.quote: Our operating expenses, excluding GST and stamp duty, have reduced at a CAGR of 8% over the last three years, an absolute 22% reduction in FY2026 compared to FY2023.

product_mix.statement: Protection mix increased to 23.4% of APE from 19.3%; savings mix moderated to 76.6% from 80.7%
product_mix.quote: The overall protection mix increased from 19.3% in H1 -FY2026 to 23.4% of APE in H1 -FY2027. Consequently, the savings business mix moderated from 80.7% in H1 -FY2026 to 76.6% in H1-FY2027.

other.statement: Claim settlement ratio 99.3% with 1.1 day TAT for non-investigated claims; early claim ratio 23% best-in-class; zero NPAs since inception
other.quote: Our claim settlement ratio remained industry -leading at 99.3% in H1-FY2027, with an average turnaround time of 1.1 days for non -investigated claims. Our early claim ratio stood at 23%, which is the best -in-class in the industry.

other.statement: Embedded value grew 12.2% YoY to ₹566.69 billion; value of in-force business grew 12% to ₹423.89 billion
other.quote: Our embedded value grew by 12.2% year-on-year to ₹ 566.69 billion at September 30th, 2026. Within the EV, the value of in -force business grew by 12% year -on-year to ₹ 423.89 billion.

guidance.statement: No future guidance on equity yield targets; will optimize franchise to fullest.
guidance.quote: Sir, we don't hazard a guess on anything that is in future. I think we have been able to build a strong franchise over time. We'll obviously do our best to optimize it to the fullest.

This is basically to cater to the increased demand which we are foreseeing in the industry as well as in the trailer segment. And also on -- as we just mentioned on our seamless project, we are looking at a further balanced capex of close to INR50-odd cr

pricing_cost.statement: Price revisions with OEMs and Tier 1s concluded; expected to support Q3 and Q4 margins
pricing_cost.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

pricing_cost.statement: Steel prices increasing every quarter; only partial compensation received in Q1 and Q2
pricing_cost.quote: Steel has been increasing, you could say, every quarter. There has been only a part of the compensation on steel as a commodity, which we have received in quarter 1. There will be further -- in quarter 1 and quarter 2, both, there's just a part of it.

product_mix.statement: Q2 revenue mix: trailer segment 49%, component business 51%; tractor ~10-11% of total
product_mix.quote: If you look into our sales segment mix for this specific quarter, our trailer segment has contributed close to 49% of our revenue, while the component business contributed the balance 51%.

other.statement: Extruded axle beam capacity utilization at 65-80% of current 4,400 axles/month output
other.quote: We are making currently 4,000 trailer axles, 4,400 trailer axles per month. On that, we are utilizing between 65% to 80% of our extruded beams, which we basically are mentioning that in the next 1 or 2 quarters, we will be switching to 100%.

other.statement: Tipping jack capacity set at 800 units; expect 50-60% utilization by Q4
other.quote: We've set a capacity of close to 800 numbers. We should be at at least 50%, 60% of that capacity by quarter 4.

guidance.statement: Maintains mid-to-high teens EBITDA growth guidance for H2 FY27 despite strong H1 overachievement
guidance.quote: we definitely stay true on the guidance, that yes, H1 has been far stronger than the guidance and we expect the trends to continue but definitely mid-to-high teens (EBITDA) for the balance of the year is something that we are anchored towards.

demand.statement: Q3 FY27 trending ahead of pace with double-digit RevPAR growth expected, driven by events and festive demand
demand.quote: we are very much on track for double-digit growth in terms of RevPAR in Q3 as well.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin expanded 246 bps; Q2 margin at 46%, up 118 bps YoY
margin.quote: For the first half as a whole, operating revenue grew 30% and operating EBITDA grew 38%, with margin expanding by 246 basis points.

order_book.statement: Over 1,000 keys under development across marquee destinations including Srinagar, Bandhavgarh, Sikkim, Ayodhya, Agra, Ranthambore, Tadoba, BKC Mumbai
order_book.quote: we now have more than 1,000 keys under development across marquee destinations.

capex.statement: Contracted pipeline capex of INR 1,432 crores for five owned hotels; INR 150 crores spent, INR 450 crores by end FY27, INR 600 crores in FY28
capex.quote: the capex for our five contracted pipelines, is Agra, Srinagar, Ayodhya, Ranthambore, Bandhavgarh is around INR1,432 crores. We have spent around INR150 crores. By the end of this year, we will be spending around INR450 crores. Next year, we are looking at spending around INR600 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Corporate rate negotiations for CY27 targeting mid-to-high double-digit growth; shifted 60-70% of static corporate rates to dynamic pricing
pricing_cost.quote: we are pitching for mid-to-high double-digit growth rates in terms of our ask rates, but the negotiations are on.

fund_raise.statement: BKC Mumbai JV to seek shareholder approval for FSI purchase; Leela and Brookfield 50-50 owners; Leela to contribute share of FSI cost
fund_raise.quote: we will now look to buy the entire FSI required for the project. Since this is a material transaction with a related party, with the JV entity, Leela will shortly reach out to the shareholders for an approval of investment.

other.statement: Direct booking contribution via brand website rose to 15.1% of room revenue in H1 FY27 from 10.5% YoY, reducing third-party channel dependency
other.quote: For H1 FY27, the contribution to The Leela brand website to room revenue rose to 15.1% from 10.5% last year, and from 5.5% 2 years ago.

other.statement: Leela Centre of Excellence delivered 4,800+ man-hours training to 280+ participants; ranked Top 100 India's Best Workplaces for Women 2026
other.quote: The Leela Centre of Excellence has already delivered over 4,800 man-hours of training and engaged more than 280 participants since launch. We were also recognized amongst the Top 100 of India's Best Workplaces for Women 2026.

guidance.statement: Raw material basket expected to increase 4-5% in Q3 FY27; NSR planned increase of 4-5% in Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: And our guidance going ahead for Q3 would be a further increase of about 4% to 5%.

guidance.statement: Capex guidance for balance of FY27 is around Rs 500 crore
guidance.quote: This is going to be roughly around INR500 crores for the balance period.

guidance.statement: Volume growth from capex expected at 1:1 to 1:1.1 asset turnover; Rs 1,130 crore expansion underway and Rs 5,000 crore planned in phases
guidance.quote: The volume growth on account of the capex would be roughly around 1:1 the asset turn, which we are expecting rather 1:1.1 you can consider because we are now taking up expansions immediately for INR1,130 crores, which is going on and then thereafter in phases for around INR5,000 crores capex.

demand.statement: Demand healthy and steady for Q3 FY27; Q4 expected to be strong due to OEM year-end closing
demand.quote: We see the demand being steady in Q3. And Q4, as we know, that will be the year-end closing for most of the OEMs also, there will be good demand coming in.

demand.statement: Replacement market seeing healthy growth momentum continuing; TBR high single-digit, PCR mid-single-digit medium-term outlook
demand.quote: So replacement market, we are seeing a healthy growth momentum, which would continue. And Q2 has definitely shown that. We are seeing category-wise, we are seeing a high single digit coming in the TBR. We are seeing a mid-single digit in the passenger car coming in the medium-term outlook.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 7.1% in Q2 FY27 from 6.8% in Q1 FY27
margin.quote: EBITDA margins (Consolidated) were recorded at 7.1% v/s 6.8% in Q1FY27.

margin.statement: Management expects some improvement in EBITDA margins in Q3 FY27 despite raw material cost pressures
margin.quote: So I see that some basic points going forward in Q3, definitely, there would be some improvement in terms of the margins.

order_book.statement: Domestic volumes up 22% YoY (OE 25%, replacement 20%); export volumes up 7% QoQ; 2/3W replacement volumes more than 2x YoY
order_book.quote: Domestic markets recorded a healthy volumes growth of 22%, driven by a robust 25% in OE Market and a similar 20% in replacement markets.

order_book.statement: Highest-ever consolidated revenue of Rs 4,850 crore in Q2 FY27, up 20% YoY; domestic sales up 32% YoY with OE up 65%
order_book.quote: We have achieved our highest-ever turnover of Rs.4,850 crore, up by 20% on a Y-o-Y basis.

order_book.statement: TBR OE volumes up 76% YoY, PCR OE volumes up 35% YoY; EV volumes surged 24% QoQ
order_book.quote: TBR and PCR segments continue to remain the cornerstone of our products strategy with an extremely robust double-digit OE volumes growth of 76% and 35%, respectively, on YoY basis.

capex.statement: Rs 1,400 crore projects recently completed; Rs 1,130 crore expansion underway; Rs 5,000 crore planned in phases
capex.quote: And the 2 nd point is because we have undertaken certain expansion projects for TBR and PCR in addition to what we have completed recently for INR1,400 crores projects.

pricing_cost.statement: Crude-based raw materials constitute 65-70% of basket; carbon black, synthetic rubber, butyl, steel cord all increased YoY and QoQ
pricing_cost.quote: As you know that crude oil-based raw material is almost in the tune of about 65% to 70%. And there, definitely carbon black, synthetic rubber, butyl, steel cord, they have all increased on a Y-o-Y basis and even on a Q-o-Q basis.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material basket increased ~9% QoQ in Q2 FY27, cumulative ~30% in last 6 months; NSR increased 7% QoQ in Q2, cumulative 11-12% in 6 months
pricing_cost.quote: We have seen the raw material whole basket increased by 9% on a Q-o-Q basis, which is on a Q1 to Q2 basis. We have seen, obviously, because of the inflationary pressure and supply chain constraint because of the West Asia. Cumulatively, we have seen a staggering 30% increase in the last 6 months.

product_mix.statement: Premium SKUs (16 inch+) constitute ~30% of passenger line volumes in H1 FY27, growing at ~20% CAGR over 2-3 years
product_mix.quote: At JK Tyre, nearly 30% of passenger line volumes sold in H1 are towards premium SKUs i.e. 16 inch & above tyres. This segment has maintained a high CAGR of nearly 20% over the past 2-3 years.

product_mix.statement: Standalone revenue mix: replacement 60%, OEM 30%, exports 10%; category mix: TBR 56%, PLR 28%, 2/3W 6%, non-truck bias 10%
product_mix.quote: Market mix for the replacement market mix is 60%, the OEM is 30% and export is 10% of the total revenue on standalone basis.

risk.statement: West Asia conflict creating inflationary pressures via commodity prices and supply chain disruptions; raw material costs up 30% in 6 months
risk.quote: The steep increase in the prices of key raw materials due to West-Asia crisis and continued volatility have triggered the inflationary pressures, impacting the profitability margins in the near term.

other.statement: Capacity utilization in India above 90% across key segments including TBR, PLR, 2/3W
other.quote: Capacity utilization levels in India remained high at above 90% across key segments including TBR, PLR, 2/3W etc.

other.statement: JK Tornel Mexico-to-US exports showing triple-digit volume growth QoQ; expecting normal sales comparable to last year by Q4 FY27
other.quote: And just to add to it that –sales from Mexico to U.S., which we call it as an export from Mexico, there we've had a triple-digit growth in terms of volume push.

guidance.statement: Targeting 11 million ton net steel production in FY27 with H2 run rate of 6 million tons
guidance.quote: Our aim is to reach to about 11-million-ton production in this financial year as targeted earlier. We have reached to a level of about 4.79 million tons in H1. And the next, that is H2, we are aiming for 6 million tons.

guidance.statement: Annual growth capex guidance of INR 7,500-10,000 crores funded through internal accruals
guidance.quote: Our stated framework envisages annual growth capex of approximately INR 7,500 crores to INR 10,000 crores, primarily funded through internal accruals, while seeking to maintain net debt to EBITDA below 1.5x through the cycle.

demand.statement: Domestic demand strong; Q3/Q4 optimistic on construction pickup post-monsoon and festival season
demand.quote: Historically, quarter 2 used to be very bad because of rainy season, constructions were at very low level. So, cement and steel, I mean, the rebars, they will always suffer in Q2. But now Q3 is very optimistic. It's a festival season, the building construction in the country going very well.

margin.statement: Adjusted EBITDA INR 2,504 crores, up 34% YoY; EBITDA per ton INR 10,529, up 5% YoY
margin.quote: Our adjusted EBITDA stood at INR 2,504 crores, up 34% Y-o-Y, while adjusted EBITDA per ton increased 5% Y-o-Y to INR 10,529 per ton.

order_book.statement: Record quarterly sales of INR 19,448 crores; 2.38 million tons volume; targeting INR 1 lakh crore annual sales
order_book.quote: The company has done wonderfully well in last quarter. We have done a record sales in the history of this company in any quarter in the last so many years. That is INR 19,448 crores. So, I think we are now on a path to reach to INR 1 lakh crores per year of sales.

pricing_cost.statement: Switched from propane (INR 100/kg) to coal syngas (INR 30/kg) saving INR 70/kg for downstream lines
pricing_cost.quote: You see the propane prices have gone up to a level of about INR 100 per kilo. And equivalent when we make coal gas, that is called syngas, then equivalent, we were getting in INR 30 a kilo. So that advantage was INR 70 a kilo.

pricing_cost.statement: Coking coal cost impact $20-25/ton expected in Q3; diesel impact $4-5/ton from West Asia conflict
pricing_cost.quote: said $12. This quarter, we are saying $20 per ton, which we expect an impact on account of the diesel. Amit Murarka: Sure. And this is beyond the coking coal inflation, right, just to be sure. Sandeep Modi: No, coking coal, I said $20 to $25. And for the West Asia conflict, which I think you are reflecting more on the diesel and other part, we did not give INR 1,200, INR 1,300. We said around $4 t

product_mix.statement: Flat product mix target 65% (including plates) vs 35% long; value-added mix 57% in Q2
product_mix.quote: We are now aiming to increase our overall product mix towards flat products. Though today also, we are at a level of about 60% -40%. Now we'll be reaching somewhere about 65%-35%, 65% flat products, including plates and 35% will be long products.

other.statement: Exporting ~100,000 tons/month (HRC, plates, rails, structures); hopeful on EU FTA and quota relaxation
other.quote: The exports are also picking up. We are doing about 100,000 tons of export every month, mainly hot-rolled coils , plates and some quantity in rails and the structures. We are hopeful the honourable Commerce Minister, Mr. Piyush Goyal, is already in And I think he is negotiating with EU on the basis of the mother of all deals, what we signed is FTA.

other.statement: Net debt reduced INR 1,141 crores to INR 14,786 crores; net debt/EBITDA improved to 1.51x
other.quote: Our consolidated net debt declined by INR 1,141 crores from INR 15,927 crores at the end of June to INR 14,786 crores as at September end. Net debt-to-EBITDA ratio improved from 1.71x to 1.51x.

guidance.statement: Transmission capex expected at INR14,000 crore for FY27 with INR8,000-9,000 crore in H2
guidance.quote: We expect to do total capex of transmission in the range of about INR14,000 crore. So we will be doing about INR8,000 crores to INR9,000 crores of capex in second half.

guidance.statement: Energy Solutions platform targets 7,000-8,000 MW consumer-side tie-ups over 3-4 years
guidance.quote: So we will continue to scale up this volume, and we will reach to about total aggregate capacity on both sides about 7,000 megawatts to 8,000 megawatts of tie up over 3 to 4 years.

demand.statement: Mumbai distribution consumption increased >10% in H1 FY27 while losses reduced to 4.29%
demand.quote: Our Distribution losses in Mumbai has reduced further to 4.29 percentage in the first half. And this despite the fact that consumption has also increased by more than 10 percentage.

margin.statement: Energy Solutions platform Q2 revenue >INR2,000 crore, EBITDA >INR800 crore
margin.quote: During this quarter, the platform delivered revenue of over INR2,000 crores and EBITDA of over INR800 crores.

order_book.statement: Transmission order book at INR87,000 crore including recently won Vizag Pendurthi and Satara projects
order_book.quote: And with these two projects, our order book remains at about INR87,000 crores.

order_book.statement: Smart Metering delivered 14.8 million meters (60% of order book), balance to complete in 12-14 months
order_book.quote: Smart Metering, we have now delivered about 14.8 million meters so far. And around 60 percentage of our order book, that we have delivered and balance portion, we wish to complete in another 12 to 14-month time.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex deployment at all-time high of INR7,850 crore across all businesses
capex.quote: the capex in this first half of the year in the all-time high. We have deployed about INR7,850 crores of capex in among all our businesses.

capex.statement: Transmission capex pipeline projects INR6,000 crore in H2 FY27 and INR18,000-19,000 crore in FY28
capex.quote: we actually expect to incur to INR6,000 crores additional capex in the second half of this year and another INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores in the FY '28.

risk.statement: Transmission commissioning delays due to ROW issues in Gujarat (Halvad); resolution expected soon at government level
risk.quote: Halvad is stacked up because of the ROW problem. And we expect resolution very soon. In fact, it is being discussed at Government of Gujarat as well as our Government of India level very frequently.

other.statement: S&P Global Electric Utility ESG rank #1 globally with 90/100 score vs industry average 40
other.quote: we are happy to say that now in S&P Global Electric Utility category, we are number one globally, getting 90 out of 100 rank, where industry average is about 40

other.statement: MAT credit assets of ~INR1,500 crore recognized for MEGPTCL and ATIL under new tax regime with corresponding recoverable liability
other.quote: See, there are two companies, MEGPTCL and ATIL, where we have decided to go to the new tax regime and recognize the past paid MAT assets in the books of account which are close to around INR1,500 crores.

guidance.statement: NIM expected to recover to approximately 5.8% by Q4 FY27 as excess liquidity is deployed and repo rate increases materialize
guidance.quote: Just in terms of how do we see NIMs going forward, we see this recovering to approximately 5.8% by Q4 as some of these excess liquidity would have been definitely put to use by them and also the expected repo rate increase, which we also are factoring for the course of the year.

guidance.statement: Bank aims to operate at 55% incremental cost-to-income ratio for FY27
guidance.quote: So we feel overall this year, i.e., in '27, we can operate the bank at 55% cost -income ratio.

guidance.statement: Loan growth visibility of at least 20% and deposit growth capacity of 21-22% on core basis
guidance.quote: So 20 -20 both sides. So you know that the income will keep flowing in strongly.

demand.statement: Mortgage, vehicle loans, consumer loans, business banking and wholesale loans each grew >30% YoY
demand.quote: The incremental growth on the loan side during the quarter was primarily driven by mortgage, vehicle loans, consumer loans and a slightly faster growth in business banking and wholesale loans, which individually grew by more than 30% on a Y-o-Y basis.

demand.statement: Loan book grew 30.1% YoY and 13.6% QoQ including FCNR; 22.2% YoY and 5.7% QoQ excluding FCNR
demand.quote: Moving on to loans. That registered a strong growth of 30.1% on a Y-o-Y basis and 13.6% on a Q-on-Q basis, including FCNR, and that book has now reached about INR3.47 lakh crores.

margin.statement: FCNR lending caused 16 bps NIM drag, excess liquidity parking caused 7 bps drag, asset mix change 5 bps, day count 4 bps
margin.quote: So to summarize, 16 bps is because of FCNR lending, 7 bps is because of excess liquidity, 4 bps is because of day count convention and 5 bps is because of other asset mix changes.

margin.statement: FCNR impact on ROA estimated at only 2 bps as expanded balance sheet reduces opex and credit cost ratios
margin.quote: And hence, we have estimated that the overall impact on the ROA could be very minimal as low as 2 basis points.

margin.statement: FCNR deposits provide ~1% cost of funds benefit vs domestic deposits including statutory benefits
margin.quote: Pursuant to the FCNR scheme, we also have estimated an additional benefit of 1%, including statutory benefits, which could accrue to us if we compare this with a normal deposit, which we would have raised otherwise.

order_book.statement: Credit cards in force crossed 5 million; outstanding book at INR9,875 crores; spends grew 15% YoY
order_book.quote: happy to report that the cards in force crossed 5 million during the quarter. The book on an outstanding basis stood at INR9,875 crores, and the credit card spends grew at a healthy pace of about 15% on a Y -o-Y basis.

order_book.statement: Mobilized INR34,390 crores (USD3.6B) FCNR(B) deposits, constituting 10% of total deposits; extended USD2.6B (INR25,000 crores) leverage to NRI customers
order_book.quote: During the quarter, the bank mobilized INR34,390 crores, which is about USD3.6 billion of FCNR (B) deposit under this scheme. This constituted about 10% of the overall deposit that we have at September 30, 2026.

capex.statement: No specific capex guidance; opex grew 16% YoY and 3.7% QoQ to INR5,942 crores; incremental cost-to-income at 55% for H1
capex.quote: Moving on, the opex for the quarter was at INR5,942 crores. This grew by 16% on a Y-o-Y basis and by 3 .7% on a sequential basis.

pricing_cost.statement: Savings account rate reduced to 6% for balances above INR25 lakhs; continuous process of moderating liability costs
pricing_cost.quote: If you notice that we were earlier paying 7% of savings accounts, then we made 6.5%, then we made 6.25%. Now we made it 6% above INR25 lakhs, we are only paying 6% now.

pricing_cost.statement: FCNR annualized cost at 6.86% vs estimated 7.8% for domestic deposits; 100 bps blended benefit on INR35,000 crores
pricing_cost.quote: So blend blend between the 6.80% to 7.80%, there is about 100 basis points benefit in having raised this money at the right juncture.

risk.statement: El Nino and drought in Maharashtra, Karnataka being monitored; no immediate asset quality impact seen for Q3/Q4 but cautious outlook
risk.quote: We are, of course, very watchful of this El Niño and the impact will cost to us that a couple of states have declared drought, etcetera. We have to see how much portfolio we have to manage that.

other.statement: CAR at 14.66%, CET1 at 13.01% as of September 2026; LCR at 125% average (139% in September due to FCNR inflows)
other.quote: The capital adequacy ratio stood at 14.66% at September with CET1 ratio of 13.01%. On the LCR, the ratio was at 125% on an average for the quarter and with September being at higher at 139%.

other.statement: Excess FCNR liquidity parked in low-yielding instruments; LCR expected to normalize to 115-116% within a month as liquidity deployed
other.quote: As we speak, in October, the further usage of this excess liquidity has happened. And as I said, we should come to the normalized levels of LCR of about 115%, 116% in a month or so.

guidance.statement: No guidance for next 2 years due to market and geopolitical uncertainty
guidance.quote: with the market and the geopolitical uncertainty, right now, we are basically not in a position to give any guidance for the next 2 years.

guidance.statement: Hoping for better festive in H2 FY27; profitability run rate to continue
guidance.quote: We are hoping to -- for a better festive than last year, but it again depends on how things move from here.

demand.statement: Revenue moderated sequentially in Q2 FY27 due to earlier festive start last year
demand.quote: while revenue moderated sequentially in a softer operating due to earlier start of festive last year

margin.statement: Operating profit before tax INR1.5 crore vs loss of INR13.3 crore in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: As a result, operating profit before tax stood at INR1.5 crores compared with an operating loss of INR13.3 crores in Q2 FY26.

margin.statement: Total expenses reduced ~20% YoY to INR34.8 crore in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: Total expenses stood at INR34.8 crores compared to INR43.3 crores in quarter 2 FY26, a reduction of approximately 20% year -on-year.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 operating profit before tax INR5.6 crore vs loss of INR20.2 crore in H1 FY26
margin.quote: Operating profit before tax stood at INR5.6 crores compared with an operating loss of INR20.2 crores in H1 FY26.

capex.statement: Exploring concerts and events in Tier 2, Tier 3 markets to grow non-FCT revenue
capex.quote: We are actually in the process of doing a lot of experiential activities in the Tier 2, Tier 3 markets. We see a lot of traction there. We also have a strong presence there. So, we are exploring concerts and other events in the Tier 2, Tier 3 markets to leverage our strength there.

product_mix.statement: Non-FCT revenue split 18-20% of total revenue
product_mix.quote: So currently, 18% to 20% of our revenues come from non -FCT contribution.

product_mix.statement: FCT/NFCT split 80/20 for Q2 FY27
product_mix.quote: NFCT -- 80/20 is the split right now for the quarter.

risk.statement: Advertising environment requires measured and client-focused approach
risk.quote: The advertising environment continues to require a measured and client-focused approach.

other.statement: Quarterly cost run rate around INR39-40 crore expected to continue
other.quote: So, if you see from last 3 quarters, basically, the cost is around this INR39 crores, INR40 crores for the quarter, and that should continue.

other.statement: Total expenses saved ~INR1 crore vs Q1 FY27; employee cost up INR60 lakh, other expenses down INR1.6 crore
other.quote: So, if you see, we are basically INR1 crores -- INR50 lakhs less than the quarter 1 in the total cost, around INR1 crores. That is what we have saved compared to Q1.

guidance.statement: October disbursements ~Rs 550 crores (muted due to holidays); expect pickup in Nov-Dec to achieve good growth over Q2
guidance.quote: See, October will be a little muted, but November and December will get picked up. So, we expect the disbursements to be somewhere around Rs. 550 crores for this month and then pick up in November and December to get to a good growth number over the previous quarter.

guidance.statement: Expect flattish credit slippages and credit cost for rest of FY27 despite industry headwinds
guidance.quote: We expect flattish credit slippages and credit cost for the rest of the year, despite the industry headwinds.

guidance.statement: Confident of comfortably crossing AUM growth guidance given for FY27
guidance.quote: we are well poised to continue our strong traction in disbursements in coming quarters, which will help us cross our growth guidance for this year very comfortably

margin.statement: NIM stable at 19.87% vs 19.97% QoQ, up 16 bps YoY; cost of funds on book eased to 8.78% from 8.80%
margin.quote: Net interest margin remained broadly stable at 19.87% as against 19.97% in Q1, and was 16 bps higher year-on-year, showing that our spreads have held up despite the drop in yields.

margin.statement: Expect spread compression of 10-15 bps on book cost of funds by FY27 exit due to repo/MCLR repricing; incremental borrowing cost seen at 8.70-8.75% in H2
margin.quote: our sense is we should be exiting FY '27 with maybe another 12-15 basis points of higher cost of funds on the book compared to where we are today. So, we are roughly at about 875 or thereabouts. We should possibly be ending the year with more around an 8.90% kind of a number.

margin.statement: Yield increase of 1% on incremental loans will take 24-36 months to fully reflect on book; book is fixed rate so existing yields unchanged
margin.quote: Our book is fixed. So, we will not be able to change the rate on the existing book. Fresh disbursements will come in at 1% higher yields. Now, for that to get absorbed on the book will take 8 quarters or so. So you will not see any meaningful impact of the yield increases on the yield for this year, but then it will gradually keep going up.

order_book.statement: Q2FY27 disbursements at Rs 2,078 crores, up 39% QoQ and 74% YoY; AUM at Rs 14,640 crores, up 6.7% QoQ and 14% YoY
order_book.quote: Our upward trajectory in disbursements continued during the current quarter as well, where we recorded our historical best disbursement of Rs. 2,078 crores, up 39% over previous quarter and 74% year -on-year. The loan book also saw robust growth with our A UM at Rs. 14,640 crores, a growth of over 6.7% over the previous quarter and 14% year -on-year.

capex.statement: Added 19 branches in Q2, 75 branches over last year; focus on deepening presence in core geographies
capex.quote: During this quarter, we added 19 branches, and over the last one year we have added 75 branches, the clear thought being focusing on deepening our presence in our core geographies and also putting up additional branches in those states, where we have been operating for a while and developed good comfort across various aspects.

pricing_cost.statement: Incremental yield hike of ~1% (100 bps) effective Oct 2026 across risk categories; yields to move from 21-23% to 22.5-23.9% range
pricing_cost.quote: About 1% Nischint, across the various risk characteristics. So the number what was about 21%-23% or so, now we will get to about 22.5% -23.9% thereabouts. So, 1% is the incremental increase across the various types of customers and risk categories.

product_mix.statement: Top-up loans ~10-15% of disbursements (~Rs 200-300 crores); incremental disbursal on top-ups ~50% of outstanding; minimum 12-18 months vintage, no DPD threshold breach, credit score not deteriorated
product_mix.quote: On the top -up part of it, today I will probably say this number is somewhere around 10%-15% of the overall disbursements. So if you have done about Rs. 2,000 crores in the last quarter, possibly the top-up number will be somewhere around Rs. 200-Rs. 300 crores out of this. And roughly, the incremental disbursal on these top-up loans will be anywhere around 50%.

other.statement: Collection efficiency improved to 98.2% from 97.7% QoQ; X-bucket collections 99.4% from 99.2%; 30+ DPD down to 11.5% from 12.38%; current bucket up to 84.78% from 83.3%
